items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(f) covers the first travel charge per contractor per invoice. One flat rate at €81 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers sealing material used to repair the failed indoor supply pipe. One piece at €26 gross.
Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) cover like-for-like replacement of the failed indoor pipe section. One metre at the €42 full-cover rate.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstating the insulation on the repaired section. One metre at the €26 full-cover rate.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers installation labour if it is distinct from the technician work on line 6; section 7.1.8(c) bars duplicate billing. The invoiced hour is valued at the €480 Installation prior.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers technician labour for the pipe repair. Nine billed units at €92 each, consistent with the full-rate technician references, total €828 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying and one equipment deployment charge per operation. One flat rate at the €580 full-cover level.

items.description: Close wall opening and paint the patch
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover closing the access opening and restoring the disturbed finish. One local repair at the €633 full-cover level.
Sections 7.1.5–7.1.6 exclude repainting the undamaged remainder because matching paint was still available, and line 8 already covers the patch. If allowed, 8 m² at €25/m² would total €200 gross.
Sections 7.1.5–7.1.6 exclude separate undamaged surfaces repainted only to match. If allowed, the single flat-rate repaint is estimated at €550 gross.
